title: Spatial Contract v1 -- Capture Image Identity and Checksum Record
$comment: Stage D1 frozen contract, version-stamped from scripts/drawn_response/schemas/capture_image_record.schema.json (unchanged structurally). This is a logical/corpus-scoped identity record, not the production DB row shape. See SPATIAL_CONTRACT.md section 2.2 for the explicit field mapping to app.response_attachments (supabase/migrations/20260815130526_response_attachments.sql, fixed by 20260818011720_response_attachments_fixes.sql) confirming the two are consistent, not parallel/incompatible: image_role ORIGINAL/derived roles map to response_attachments.kind ('original'/'derived'); sha256 maps to sha256_digest; a derived image's source_image_id relationship mirrors replaces_attachment_id's retake-lineage pattern (though replaces_attachment_id chains originals across retakes, while source_image_id points a derivative at the single original it was produced from -- these are two different edges, both required, see SPATIAL_CONTRACT.md). A derived image never replaces its source image, matching the production table's 'rows are never deleted' invariant.

image_id.description: Unique immutable ID for this exact byte sequence.

source_image_id.description: Null only for ORIGINAL. Every derivative points to the immutable original.

file_name.description: Corpus-relative file name or storage object name; never a public URL.
